thread:
Olivia: Customer on private EU deployment (acct 8833-prod) reporting intermittent 502/500 and p99 ~700ms calling /v1/chat. They say responses sometimes come from us-east and latency spikes.
Hector: Any details on their network path? MPLS / partner peering?
Olivia: Yep. On-prem -> partner PoP -> our peering. Traceroute shows exit at 52.12.34.56. Sample curl they sent:

curl -v https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>"
> Connected to 52.12.34.56 (52.12.34.56) port 443
...
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
x-redwood-region: us-east-1

Maya: So their egress is SNAT'ed to a US PoP IP. Our edge uses IP geolocation to choose region, so that explains routing.
Hector: Short-term mitigation ideas: 1) add an account-level egress IP -> region override 2) request their partner to egress via EU PoP 3) have them preserve original source (X-Forwarded-For) — but note XFF won't affect initial region decision.
Olivia: They replied they can't stop SNAT due to legacy firewall. They can provide the egress IP list.
Maya: Important: our router decides region at TCP/connection time based on source IP; HTTP headers are too late. So X-Forwarded-For won't prevent the wrong-region selection.
Hector: I'll open INF-9922 to add account egress overrides and apply a temporary mapping for their block. Applying 52.12.34.56/32 -> eu-west-1 for account 8833-prod now.
Nina (billing): Noted that traffic got billed against us-east dedicated capacity. Created provisional credit CR-2026-777 pending approval.
Hector: After override tests: traceroute now goes to our eu edge and responses include x-redwood-region: eu-west-1.
Olivia: Customer reports p99 down from ~720ms to ~95ms and timeouts stopped.
Maya: For permanent fix: we should change the router precedence so account.private_region wins over geo-IP for connections tied to dedicated/private deployments. That will need QA and a 24-48h rollout.
Hector: Agreed — INF-9922 will track the permanent router change.
Olivia: Also adding an eng-net doc entry: "Geo-IP heuristics fragile with MPLS/partner SNAT" so support/solutions engineering can triage faster.
deploy-bot: Deployed routing override for account 8833-prod to prod at 2026-05-19T09:11:02Z
Olivia: Leaving thread open until INF-9922 resolved and billing credit finalised. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
